name: Exactly Protocol DebtManager unvalidated-market impersonation
summary: DebtManager accepted a caller-supplied market in its permit and leverage path without checking that the Auditor listed it. A malicious market bypassed the permit, set DebtManager's effective sender to a victim, then reentered crossDeleverage with a real market to withdraw the victim's position through an attacker-controlled swap pool.
notes: The proxy creation transaction emitted Upgraded selecting the vulnerable DebtManager implementation; no later Upgraded event occurred before the exploit.
Exactly's post-mortem reports $7,612,038 lost by 117 accounts. The main attacker caused 97% of the campaign loss and a copycat using the same defect caused the remaining 3%.
The loss uses Exactly's account-level aggregate rather than a separately repriced onchain asset ledger.
